item.title: Lina’s First Haircut
item.summary: A child and a hairdresser find a quiet way to finish her first visit.
item.content_markdown:
Lina goes to the hairdresser with her dad. She sees a big chair in front of a mirror. There is an empty chair for her dad by the window. Lina sits in the big chair, but she does not want the man to turn on the loud machine.

The man puts the machine down. He takes a pair of scissors and cuts a little hair at the front. Lina counts to ten while he works. When she gets to ten, she looks in the mirror. She can see both eyes. “Good,” she says. “Now do the back.”

Lina’s dad gives her a small mirror when the man finishes. She holds it so she can see the back of her head. The man asks if she wants a picture. “No, thank you,” Lina says. “I want to show my brother when I get home.”
